name: Felgur Twocuts
summary: Felgur Twocuts is a blunt orc scout stationed at Ghost Walker Post in Desolace. He coordinates Horde efforts against the regional centaur clans.

sections.title: A Gruff Outpost Scout
sections.body: Standing watch amid the bleak expanse of Ghost Walker Post in central Desolace, Felgur Twocuts has little patience for pleasantries. As a forward scout for the Horde, he assesses the threats facing travelers and settlers venturing west through the mountains, particularly the local Kolkar centaur.

sections.title: War on the Centaur
sections.body: Felgur directs Horde champions to cull the local centaur chieftains and collect bounties on the warring tribes who threaten to overrun the region. He is a central contact for anyone seeking to secure the Horde's foothold in Desolace.

faq.answer: Felgur Twocuts is an orc scout and quest giver stationed at Ghost Walker Post, the Horde's forward encampment in Desolace.

faq.q: Where can I find Felgur Twocuts?
faq.answer: He is located at Ghost Walker Post, just north of the central road running through Desolace.

faq.q: What tasks does Felgur Twocuts give?
faq.answer: Felgur enlists Horde adventurers to strike at the local Kolkar centaur, hunt down Khan Dez'hepah, and collect bounties on hostile centaur.

faq.q: Why is Felgur so curt with visitors?
faq.answer: Desolace is a dangerous and unforgiving wasteland surrounded by hostile centaur clans. Stationed in an isolated post, Felgur has no time for idle chatter and prefers to focus strictly on survival and martial duty.

angles.text: Felgur acts as a vital operations liaison at Ghost Walker Post, helping the Horde push back aggressive centaur tribes in Desolace.
True to standard orcish pragmatism in dangerous borderlands, Felgur values strength, speed, and immediate results over idle conversation.
